@@ -0,0 +1,393 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+
+from packaging.version import Version
+
+from pip_audit._audit import AuditOptions, Auditor
+from pip_audit._dependency_source import DependencySource
+from pip_audit._service import (
+    Dependency,
+    ResolvedDependency,
+    VulnerabilityResult,
+    VulnerabilityService,
+)
+
+
+def _dep(name: str = "demo-pkg", version: str = "1.0.0") -> ResolvedDependency:
+    return ResolvedDependency(name=name, version=Version(version))
+
+
+def _vuln(id_: str, aliases: set[str]) -> VulnerabilityResult:
+    return VulnerabilityResult(
+        id=id_,
+        description=f"desc {id_}",
+        fix_versions=[Version("2.0.0")],
+        aliases=aliases,
+    )
+
+
+class RecordingSource(DependencySource):
+    def __init__(self, deps: list[Dependency]):
+        self.deps = deps
+        self.collect_calls = 0
+
+    def collect(self) -> Iterator[Dependency]:
+        self.collect_calls += 1
+        yield from self.deps
+
+    def fix(self, _fix_version) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class RecordingService(VulnerabilityService):
+    def __init__(self, responses: dict[str, list[VulnerabilityResult]]):
+        self.responses = responses
+        self.query_all_calls = 0
+        self.spec_batches: list[list[Dependency]] = []
+
+    def query(self, spec: Dependency) -> tuple[Dependency, list[VulnerabilityResult]]:
+        return spec, self.responses[spec.name]
+
+    def query_all(
+        self, specs: Iterator[Dependency]
+    ) -> Iterator[tuple[Dependency, list[VulnerabilityResult]]]:
+        self.query_all_calls += 1
+        batch = list(specs)
+        self.spec_batches.append(batch)
+        for dep in batch:
+            yield dep, self.responses[dep.name]
+
+
+def _summary(
+    results: list[tuple[Dependency, list[VulnerabilityResult]]],
+) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[tuple[str, list[str]]]]]:
+
+
+    return sorted(
+        [
+            (
+                dep.name,
+                str(dep.version),
+                sorted(
+                    [
+                        (
+                            vuln.id,
+                            sorted(vuln.aliases),
+                        )
+                        for vuln in vulns
+                    ],
+                    key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]),
+                ),
+            )
+            for dep, vulns in results
+        ],
+        key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]),
+    )
+
+
+def _service_batches_summary(
+    service: RecordingService,
+) -> list[set[tuple[str, str]]]:
+
+
+    return [
+        {(dep.name, str(dep.version)) for dep in batch} for batch in service.spec_batches
+    ]
+
+
+def test_audit_collapses_two_records_and_merges_aliases() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    dep = _dep()
+    source = RecordingSource([dep])
+    service = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+                _vuln("GHSA-aaaa", {"CVE-2024-0001", "GHSA-aaaa"}),
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+
+    assert source.collect_calls == 0
+    assert service.query_all_calls == 0
+
+    results = list(Auditor(service, options=AuditOptions()).audit(source))
+
+    assert _summary(results) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001", "GHSA-aaaa"])],
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+    assert source.collect_calls >= 1
+    assert service.query_all_calls >= 1
+    assert _service_batches_summary(service) == [{("demo-pkg", "1.0.0")}]
+
+
+def test_pysec_result_wins_when_provider_returns_it_second() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    dep = _dep()
+    source = RecordingSource([dep])
+    service = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("GHSA-aaaa", {"CVE-2024-0001", "GHSA-aaaa"}),
+                _vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+
+    results = list(Auditor(service).audit(source))
+
+    assert _summary(results) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001", "GHSA-aaaa"])],
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+    assert source.collect_calls >= 1
+    assert service.query_all_calls >= 1
+
+
+def test_three_alias_linked_records_collapse_to_one_pysec_result() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    dep = _dep()
+    source = RecordingSource([dep])
+    service = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+                _vuln("GHSA-aaaa", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+                _vuln("CVE-2024-0001", {"GHSA-aaaa"}),
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+
+    results = list(Auditor(service).audit(source))
+
+    assert _summary(results) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001", "GHSA-aaaa"])],
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+    assert source.collect_calls >= 1
+    assert service.query_all_calls >= 1
+
+
+def test_audit_deduplicates_each_dependency_independently() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    first = _dep("demo-pkg", "1.0.0")
+    second = _dep("other-pkg", "4.5.6")
+    source = RecordingSource([first, second])
+    service = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+                _vuln("GHSA-aaaa", {"CVE-2024-0001", "GHSA-aaaa"}),
+            ],
+            "other-pkg": [
+                _vuln("GHSA-bbbb", {"CVE-2024-0002"}),
+                _vuln("PYSEC-1", {"CVE-2024-0002"}),
+            ],
+        }
+    )
+
+    results = list(Auditor(service).audit(source))
+
+    assert _summary(results) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001", "GHSA-aaaa"])],
+        ),
+        (
+            "other-pkg",
+            "4.5.6",
+            [("PYSEC-1", ["CVE-2024-0002"])],
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
+    assert source.collect_calls >= 1
+    assert service.query_all_calls >= 1
+    assert _service_batches_summary(service) == [
+        {("demo-pkg", "1.0.0"), ("other-pkg", "4.5.6")}
+    ]
+
+
+def test_audit_preserves_distinct_non_overlapping_vulnerabilities() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    dep = _dep()
+    source = RecordingSource([dep])
+    service = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+                _vuln("GHSA-bbbb", {"CVE-2024-0002"}),
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+
+    results = list(Auditor(service).audit(source))
+
+    assert _summary(results) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [
+                ("GHSA-bbbb", ["CVE-2024-0002"]),
+                ("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001"]),
+            ],
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+    assert source.collect_calls >= 1
+    assert service.query_all_calls >= 1
+
+
+def test_default_options_collects_source_and_queries_service() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    dep = _dep()
+    source = RecordingSource([dep])
+    service = RecordingService({"demo-pkg": [_vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"})]})
+
+
+
+    results = list(Auditor(service, options=AuditOptions()).audit(source))
+
+    assert _summary(results) == [
+        ("demo-pkg", "1.0.0", [("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001"])])
+    ]
+
+
+    assert source.collect_calls >= 1
+    assert service.query_all_calls >= 1
+    assert _service_batches_summary(service) == [{("demo-pkg", "1.0.0")}]
+
+
+def test_same_auditor_uses_current_service_results_on_repeated_audits() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    dep = _dep()
+    service = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+                _vuln("GHSA-aaaa", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+    auditor = Auditor(service)
+
+    first_results = list(auditor.audit(RecordingSource([dep])))
+    service.responses = {
+        "demo-pkg": [
+            _vuln("PYSEC-9", {"CVE-2024-0009"}),
+            _vuln("GHSA-zzzz", {"CVE-2024-0009"}),
+        ]
+    }
+    second_results = list(auditor.audit(RecordingSource([dep])))
+
+    assert _summary(first_results) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001"])],
+        )
+    ]
+    assert _summary(second_results) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-9", ["CVE-2024-0009"])],
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+    assert service.query_all_calls >= 2
+
+
+def test_two_auditor_instances_keep_their_services_independent() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    dep = _dep()
+    service_a = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("PYSEC-0", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+                _vuln("GHSA-aaaa", {"CVE-2024-0001"}),
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+    service_b = RecordingService(
+        {
+            "demo-pkg": [
+                _vuln("PYSEC-9", {"CVE-2024-0009"}),
+                _vuln("GHSA-zzzz", {"CVE-2024-0009"}),
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+
+    result_a = list(Auditor(service_a).audit(RecordingSource([dep])))
+    result_b = list(Auditor(service_b).audit(RecordingSource([dep])))
+
+    assert _summary(result_a) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-0", ["CVE-2024-0001"])],
+        )
+    ]
+    assert _summary(result_b) == [
+        (
+            "demo-pkg",
+            "1.0.0",
+            [("PYSEC-9", ["CVE-2024-0009"])],
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+    assert service_a.query_all_calls >= 1
+    assert service_b.query_all_calls >= 1

+import pytest
+from packaging.version import Version
+
+from pip_audit._audit import AuditOptions, Auditor
+from pip_audit._service import ResolvedDependency, VulnerabilityResult
+
+
+class Source:
+    def __init__(self, dependency):
+        self.dependency = dependency
+
+    def collect(self):
+        yield self.dependency
+
+
+class Service:
+    def __init__(self, records):
+        self.records = records
+
+    def query_all(self, dependencies):
+        for dependency in dependencies:
+            yield dependency, self.records
+
+
+def advisory(primary, aliases):
+    return VulnerabilityResult(
+        id=primary,
+        description='Synthetic advisory',
+        fix_versions=[Version('2.0.0')],
+        aliases=set(aliases),
+    )
+
+
+def audited(records):
+    dependency = ResolvedDependency(name='demo-pkg', version=Version('1.0.0'))
+    results = list(
+        Auditor(Service(records), options=AuditOptions()).audit(Source(dependency))
+    )
+    assert len(results) == 1
+    assert results[0][0] == dependency
+    vulnerabilities = list(results[0][1])
+    assert len(vulnerabilities) == 1
+    return vulnerabilities[0]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('reverse', [False, True])
+def test_non_pysec_duplicate_excludes_emitted_primary(reverse):
+    identifiers = {'GHSA-aaaa', 'CVE-2024-0001'}
+    records = [
+        advisory('GHSA-aaaa', {'CVE-2024-0001'}),
+        advisory('CVE-2024-0001', {'GHSA-aaaa'}),
+    ]
+    if reverse:
+        records.reverse()
+    result = audited(records)
+    assert result.id in identifiers
+    assert result.id not in result.aliases
+    assert result.aliases == identifiers - {result.id}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('reverse', [False, True])
+def test_pysec_duplicate_excludes_selected_primary(reverse):
+    records = [
+        advisory('GHSA-aaaa', {'CVE-2024-0001', 'PYSEC-0'}),
+        advisory('PYSEC-0', {'CVE-2024-0001', 'GHSA-aaaa'}),
+    ]
+    if reverse:
+        records.reverse()
+    result = audited(records)
+    assert result.id == 'PYSEC-0'
+    assert result.id not in result.aliases
+    assert result.aliases == {'CVE-2024-0001', 'GHSA-aaaa'}

(
bash /workspace/repo/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /workspace/repo || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
/usr/bin/python -m pytest usercase-test-coderl/test_repair_primary_alias_exclusion.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
